title: Concept: JBoss welcome console reachable
description: The JBoss welcome page with its administration links in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The page advertises the admin consoles and their versions, which is the entry point list for anyone who found the host and wants to try default credentials.
applicability: Deployments that render the JBoss welcome page with its administration links into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The page advertises the admin consoles and their versions, which is the entry point list for anyone who found the host and wants to try default credentials.
